upgrade.title: Hali ham “very good”mi?
upgrade.subtitle: Speaking va Writing uchun darajangizni ko‘taring
upgrade.caption: 📌 Qoida: “very + oddiy sifat” o‘rniga bitta kuchli sifat ishlating. Bunday sifatlar oldiga “very” qo‘yilmaydi: ❌ very exhausted → ✅ absolutely exhausted. 🗣 Misol: I was exhausted after the exam, but delighted with my score.

upgrade.title: Phrasal verb o‘rniga 1 ta fe'l
upgrade.subtitle: Writing Task 2 da rasmiyroq yangraydi
upgrade.caption: 📌 Speakingda phrasal verb'lar tabiiy va yaxshi. Lekin Writing Task 2 da bitta rasmiy fe'l kuchliroq yangraydi. ✍️ Misol: Governments should consider ways to improve public transport.

upgrade.title: Speakingda fikr bildirish
upgrade.subtitle: “I think” ni har gapda takrorlamang
upgrade.caption: 📌 “I think” xato emas, lekin har javobda takrorlansa Lexical Resource bali tushadi. Har safar boshqasini ishlating. 🗣 Misol: Do you like reading? — Oh, I'm really into it, especially detective novels.

upgrade.title: Bog‘lovchilarni almashtiring
upgrade.subtitle: Coherence & Cohesion balingiz uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Ehtiyot bo‘ling: however odatda yangi gap boshida keladi va undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. ❌ I like it, however it is expensive. ✅ I like it. However, it is expensive.

upgrade.title: Task 1: grafikni tasvirlash
upgrade.subtitle: Chiziqli grafik va jadvallar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Fe'lga ravish qo‘shsangiz, tasvir aniqroq bo‘ladi: increased steadily (barqaror o‘sdi), dropped slightly (biroz tushdi). ✍️ Misol: Sales peaked at 80% in 2015 and then declined gradually.

upgrade.title: “A lot of” ni unuting
upgrade.subtitle: Miqdorni aniqroq va rasmiyroq ifodalang
upgrade.caption: 📌 Diqqat: a number of + sanaladigan ot (students), an amount of + sanalmaydigan ot (money). ✍️ Misol: A significant proportion of young people work part-time.

upgrade.title: “Good” va “bad” dan voz keching
upgrade.subtitle: Essayda aniqroq sifatlar ishlating
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu sifatlar ko‘pincha predlog bilan keladi: beneficial to, detrimental to. ✍️ Misol: Excessive screen time is detrimental to children's eyesight.

upgrade.title: Speaking Part 1: “Yes” dan keyin
upgrade.subtitle: Qisqa javob o‘rniga tabiiy boshlang
upgrade.caption: 📌 Part 1 da faqat “Yes” yoki “No” deb to‘xtamang. Boshlovchi iboradan keyin yana 1–2 gap qo‘shing. 🗣 Misol: Do you cook often? — More often than not, yes. I usually make dinner for my family.

upgrade.title: His-tuyg‘ularni aniq ayting
upgrade.subtitle: “very sad” o‘rniga bitta kuchli so‘z
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu so‘zlar Speaking Part 2 dagi “Describe a time when…” savollarida juda kerak bo‘ladi. 🗣 Misol: I was absolutely terrified before my first exam, but astonished by my result.

upgrade.title: Odamni tasvirlang
upgrade.subtitle: “Describe a person” savollari uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bitta sifat yetarli emas: uni misol bilan isbotlang. 🗣 Misol: My teacher is really approachable. You can ask her anything, even after class.

upgrade.title: Joyni tasvirlang
upgrade.subtitle: Shahar, park, kafe haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 bustling ijobiy (jonli, gavjum), crowded esa ko‘pincha salbiy ma'noda keladi. 🗣 Misol: The old town is bustling during the day but surprisingly tranquil at night.

upgrade.title: Oddiy fe'llarni kuchaytiring
upgrade.subtitle: Writing Task 2 uchun rasmiy variantlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 Speakingda “get” va “buy” tabiiy. Rasmiy fe'llar ko‘proq Writingga mos. ✍️ Misol: Social media can exacerbate loneliness rather than enhance friendships.

upgrade.title: Education mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ta'lim haqidagi essaylar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Education IELTS Writing Task 2 dagi eng ko‘p uchraydigan mavzulardan biri. ✍️ Misol: Regular assessment helps educators identify students who might drop out.

upgrade.title: Environment mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Atrof-muhit essaylari uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu so‘zlar ko‘pincha fe'l bilan juft keladi: tackle air pollution, combat deforestation. ✍️ Misol: Governments must take urgent action to combat deforestation.

upgrade.title: Technology mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Texnologiya haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 hooked norasmiy, Speakingga mos. Writingda addicted to yoki dependent on deng. 🗣 Misol: Smartphones have become indispensable, and many teenagers are hooked.

upgrade.title: Health mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Sog‘liq haqidagi savollar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 “fat” odamga nisbatan qo‘pol eshitiladi. IELTSda doim overweight deng. ✍️ Misol: People who have a poor diet are more likely to put on weight.

upgrade.title: Work mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ish va kasb haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 be made redundant — ish qisqarishi tufayli bo‘shatilmoq. “fired” esa aybi uchun bo‘shatilganda. 🗣 Misol: My father has a high-pressure job and often puts in long hours.

upgrade.title: Vaqt iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Writing va Task 1 uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Task 1 da vaqt iboralari trendni aniq ko‘rsatadi. ✍️ Misol: Sales grew rapidly and eventually doubled, while costs rose annually.

upgrade.title: Sabab va natija
upgrade.subtitle: Essayda fikrni bog‘lash uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 leads to va contributes to dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: leads to pollution, contributes to improving. ✍️ Misol: Urbanisation leads to congestion, which contributes to air pollution.

upgrade.title: Taqqoslash iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Task 1 va Task 2 uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 whereas ikki qarama-qarshi faktni bitta gapda bog‘laydi. ✍️ Misol: Men preferred football, whereas women's figures were comparable across all sports.

upgrade.title: Speakingda o‘ylanish iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Jim qolish o‘rniga shularni ayting
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu iboralar o‘ylash uchun 2–3 soniya beradi va Fluency balini saqlab qoladi. 🗣 Misol: Hmm, that's a tricky one. I'd say it depends on the person's age.

upgrade.title: City mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Shahar hayoti haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 affordable housing — essaylarda juda ko‘p uchraydigan juftlik. ✍️ Misol: Many residents of the metropolis struggle to find affordable housing.

upgrade.title: Pul haqida gapirish
upgrade.subtitle: Speaking va Writing uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 splash out on norasmiy va Speakingda zo‘r eshitiladi. Writingda spend heavily on deng. 🗣 Misol: I rarely splash out, but I bought exorbitant concert tickets last year.

upgrade.title: Travel mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Sayohat haqidagi savollar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 accommodation sanalmaydigan ot: “accommodations” ❌. Imlosi ham tez-tez xato yoziladi: ikkita c, ikkita m. 🗣 Misol: We went sightseeing all day and the scenery was stunning.

upgrade.title: Sport va hobbi
upgrade.subtitle: Bo‘sh vaqt haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 take up — yangi mashg‘ulotni boshlamoq, give up — tashlamoq. 🗣 Misol: I took up swimming last year, and now I work out three times a week.

upgrade.title: Essay xulosasi
upgrade.subtitle: Conclusion paragrafi uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Xulosada yangi fikr qo‘shmang: faqat pozitsiyangizni boshqa so‘zlar bilan takrorlang. ✍️ Misol: Having considered both sides, I believe it is essential that governments act now.

upgrade.title: Family mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Oila haqida Band 7+ so‘zlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 take after faqat ota-ona yoki katta qarindoshga o‘xshashlik uchun ishlatiladi. 🗣 Misol: I take after my father; we share a close bond.

upgrade.title: Food mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ovqat haqida tabiiy gapiring
upgrade.caption: 📌 starving va mouth-watering oldiga “very” qo‘yilmaydi, ular o‘zi kuchli. 🗣 Misol: Nothing beats my mum's home-cooked meals.

upgrade.title: Shopping mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Xarid haqida aniqroq so‘zlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 splurge on — bir narsaga ko‘p pul sarflab yubormoq. 🗣 Misol: I rarely splurge on designer labels; I'd rather find a bargain.

upgrade.title: Media mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Yangiliklar va OAV haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 misinformation sanalmaydigan ot: “a misinformation” deyilmaydi. ✍️ Misol: Social media accelerates the spread of misinformation.

upgrade.title: Crime mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Jinoyat haqida Writing so‘zlari
upgrade.caption: 📌 deter — qo‘rqitib, to‘xtatib qolmoq. Crime essaylarda eng ko‘p kerak bo‘ladigan fe'l. ✍️ Misol: Harsh penalties may not deter young offenders.

upgrade.title: Government mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Hukumat va qonun haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 allocate funds to + soha: allocate funds to healthcare. ✍️ Misol: The authorities should allocate more funds to public transport.

upgrade.title: Culture mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Madaniyat haqida aniq so‘zlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 heritage — avloddan-avlodga o‘tgan qadriyatlar. ✍️ Misol: Tourism can help preserve a nation's cultural heritage.

upgrade.title: Art va musiqa
upgrade.subtitle: San'at haqida gapirish
upgrade.caption: 📌 have something on repeat — bir qo‘shiqni qayta-qayta tinglamoq. Speaking Part 1 uchun ajoyib. 🗣 Misol: Lately I've had this song on repeat.

upgrade.title: Kitob va film
upgrade.subtitle: Speaking Part 2 uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 gripping — o‘qishni to‘xtatib bo‘lmaydigan darajada qiziqarli. 🗣 Misol: The plot was so gripping that I finished it in one night.

upgrade.title: Transport mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Yo‘l va transport haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 commute ham fe'l, ham ot: my daily commute. ✍️ Misol: Investing in public transport reduces congestion at peak hours.

upgrade.title: Housing mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Uy-joy haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 rent sanalmaydigan ot: “a rent” emas, “the rent”. ✍️ Misol: Rising property prices force young people to rent.

upgrade.title: Weather mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ob-havo haqida tabiiy
upgrade.caption: 📌 scorching va freezing oldiga “very” qo‘ymang, “absolutely” deyish mumkin. 🗣 Misol: Summers in Tashkent are absolutely scorching.

upgrade.title: Science mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Fan va tadqiqot haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 research sanalmaydi: “researches” emas, “studies” deyish mumkin. ✍️ Misol: Research shows that cutting-edge technology improves diagnosis.

upgrade.title: Animals mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Hayvonlar haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 wildlife sanalmaydigan ot, ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi olmaydi. ✍️ Misol: Deforestation destroys the habitat of many endangered species.

upgrade.title: Globalization
upgrade.subtitle: Global dunyo haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 Writing'da “all over the world” o‘rniga worldwide yoki across the globe ishlating. ✍️ Misol: Globalisation may homogenise cultures worldwide.

upgrade.title: Advertising mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Reklama haqida Task 2
upgrade.caption: 📌 mislead — chalg‘itmoq. Ot shakli: misleading advertising. ✍️ Misol: Some adverts deliberately mislead consumers.

upgrade.title: Tourism mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Turizm haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 overtourism — sayyohlar haddan ziyod ko‘pligi. Zamonaviy essay mavzusi. ✍️ Misol: Overtourism can harm the lives of locals.

upgrade.title: Energy mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Energiya haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 fossil fuels doim ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. ✍️ Misol: Fossil fuels will eventually be depleted.

upgrade.title: Social media
upgrade.subtitle: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 go viral — juda tez tarqalib, mashhur bo‘lib ketmoq. 🗣 Misol: One of my videos went viral last year.

upgrade.title: Friendship mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Do‘stlik haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 hit it off — birinchi uchrashuvdayoq til topishmoq. 🗣 Misol: We hit it off immediately and became lifelong friends.

upgrade.title: Childhood mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Bolalik haqida gapirish
upgrade.caption: 📌 O‘tmishdagi odatlar uchun used to yoki would ishlating. 🗣 Misol: I vividly recall how I used to play outside all day.

upgrade.title: Old age mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Keksalar haqida Task 2
upgrade.caption: 📌 Rasmiy yozuvda “old people” o‘rniga the elderly yoki senior citizens deng. ✍️ Misol: As life expectancy rises, more care for the elderly is needed.

upgrade.title: Success mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Muvaffaqiyat haqida
upgrade.caption: 📌 achieve bilan juftlik: achieve a goal / success / ambition. “make a goal” deyilmaydi. 🗣 Misol: If you persevere, you'll achieve your goal.

upgrade.title: Leadership mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Rahbar haqida gapirish
upgrade.caption: 📌 delegate — ishni boshqalarga taqsimlab bermoq. 🗣 Misol: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.

upgrade.title: Task 1: foizlar
upgrade.subtitle: Raqamlarni so‘z bilan
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bir xil raqamni takrorlamaslik uchun foizni so‘z bilan almashtiring. ✍️ Misol: A quarter of students walked to school, while the majority took the bus.

upgrade.title: Task 1: taxminiy raqamlar
upgrade.subtitle: Aniq bo‘lmagan raqamlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 Grafikdagi raqam aniq ko‘rinmasa approximately yoki roughly ishlating. ✍️ Misol: Sales reached just over 3 million in 2010.

upgrade.title: Task 1: process fe'llari
upgrade.subtitle: Jarayon diagrammasi uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Process diagrammada asosan passive voice ishlatiladi. ✍️ Misol: The beans are roasted and then ground into powder.

upgrade.title: Task 1: xarita fe'llari
upgrade.subtitle: Xaritadagi o‘zgarishlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 Xarita savolida o‘zgarishlarni passive va present perfect / past simple bilan yozing. ✍️ Misol: The factory was demolished and converted into a park.

upgrade.title: Daraja ravishlari
upgrade.subtitle: “very” o‘rniga
upgrade.caption: 📌 considerably / significantly + qiyosiy sifat: considerably cheaper. ✍️ Misol: Prices are considerably higher than a decade ago.

upgrade.title: Takrorlanish ravishlari
upgrade.subtitle: Qanchalik tez-tez?
upgrade.caption: 📌 hardly ever — deyarli hech qachon. Gapda “not” bilan birga ishlatilmaydi. 🗣 Misol: I hardly ever watch TV; I read on a daily basis.

upgrade.title: Urg‘u berish iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Fikringizni kuchaytiring
upgrade.caption: 📌 needless to say gap boshida, vergul bilan keladi. ✍️ Misol: Needless to say, education is particularly important.

upgrade.title: Muammo so‘zlari
upgrade.subtitle: “problem” ni almashtiring
upgrade.caption: 📌 exacerbate — (muammoni) battar qilmoq. Band 8 fe'li. ✍️ Misol: Urban sprawl exacerbates traffic issues.

upgrade.title: Yechim so‘zlari
upgrade.subtitle: Yechim taklif qilish
upgrade.caption: 📌 tackle / address + muammo: tackle unemployment. ✍️ Misol: Governments must tackle pollution and curb emissions.

upgrade.title: Afzallik va kamchilik
upgrade.subtitle: Advantage essay uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 outweigh — og‘irroq kelmoq: the benefits outweigh the drawbacks. ✍️ Misol: In my view, the benefits clearly outweigh the downsides.

upgrade.title: Speaking Part 2: hikoya
upgrade.subtitle: Voqeani jonli aytib bering
upgrade.caption: 📌 be over the moon — juda xursand bo‘lmoq. Part 2 dagi his-tuyg‘ular uchun. 🗣 Misol: All of a sudden, my name was called and I was over the moon.

pov.question: Do you prefer mornings or evenings?
pov.better: I'm definitely a night owl. My brain only really wakes up after sunset, so I do my best work in the evenings.
pov.lesson: Idioma tabiiy qo‘shilsa, Lexical Resource bali ko‘tariladi.

pov.question: Can you repeat the question, please?
pov.better: Sorry, could you repeat the question, please?
pov.lesson: Savolni tushunmasangiz, muloyim so‘rang. Bu ball tushirmaydi.

pov.question: Should the government spend more on public transport?
pov.better: I'd say so, yes. Better public transport would ease congestion and cut pollution, which benefits everyone, not just commuters.
pov.lesson: Fikr + 2 ta sabab + kimga foydasi. Part 3 formulasi.

pov.question: Describe a time you helped someone.
pov.bad: I helped my neighbour. It was nice.
pov.better: I'm going to describe a time I helped my elderly neighbour move house. It took a whole day, but seeing how grateful she was made it worth it.
pov.lesson: Part 2 da his-tuyg‘u bilan tugating: how you felt.

pov.question: Do you use public transport?
pov.better: Yes, quite often. I take the metro to university because it's fast and much cheaper than a taxi.
pov.lesson: “Sometimes” ni kengaytiring: qachon, nima uchun.

pov.question: Do you like shopping?
pov.better: Not particularly. I find crowded malls exhausting, so I tend to shop online instead.
pov.lesson: Savoldagi so‘zlarni takrorlamang. Parafraza qiling.

pov.question: How has your city changed in recent years?
pov.better: It's changed beyond recognition. Lots of modern high-rises have gone up, and the metro has been extended to the suburbs.
pov.lesson: O‘zgarishlar haqida present perfect ishlating.

pov.question: What's your favourite season?
pov.better: I'd have to say spring. The weather's mild, everything's in bloom, and it's perfect for long walks.
pov.lesson: Javobni boshlash uchun “I'd have to say” juda tabiiy eshitiladi.

pov.question: Do you think robots will replace teachers?
pov.better: I doubt it. While AI can deliver information, it can't replace the emotional support and motivation a good teacher provides.
pov.lesson: Qarama-qarshi fikrni “While…” bilan tan oling, keyin o‘z fikringizni ayting.

pov.question: Do you have a lot of friends?
pov.better: I wouldn't say a lot, but I have a small circle of close friends I can always count on.
pov.lesson: Sifat miqdordan muhimroq: aniq tafsilot bering.

pov.question: Tell me about your hometown.
pov.better: I'm from Bukhara, which is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia. It's famous for its well-preserved mosques and madrasas.
pov.lesson: Shahar nomidan keyin “which…” bilan qiziqarli fakt qo‘shing.

pov.question: Do you like getting up early?
pov.better: Honestly, not at all. I'm not a morning person, so I need at least two cups of tea to function properly.
pov.lesson: “I don't like” dan keyin obyekt kerak. Yaxshisi butun gap bilan javob bering.
